subject: ela
intro: Grade-appropriate vocabulary includes general academic words that appear across many subjects (such as analyze, compare, and significant) and domain-specific words tied to one field (such as photosynthesis in science or hypotenuse in math). In these problems, each sentence is provided for you. Use the direct clue in the sentence to choose the precise word, name a word's field, or sort a word as general academic or domain-specific.

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'The teacher asked us to ______ the two stories by listing how they were alike and how they were different.' Which word best completes the sentence: compare or shout?

steps: Look for the clue: the sentence says to list how the stories were alike and different.
The word 'compare' means to look at how two things are similar and different.
'Shout' means to yell, which does not match the clue about alike and different.
The best word is 'compare.'

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'In science class we studied photosynthesis, the process a plant uses to make its own food from sunlight.' Is the word 'photosynthesis' a general academic word or a domain-specific science word?

steps: A domain-specific word is tied to one field, like science, math, or history.
'Photosynthesis' names a process that happens only in the field of science.
It does not appear across many subjects, so it is not a general academic word.
The word 'photosynthesis' is a domain-specific science word.

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'Before the test, the coach told the players to ______ their plan carefully and look closely at each part.' Which word best completes the sentence: analyze or ignore?

steps: The clue says to look closely at each part of the plan.
'Analyze' means to examine something closely, part by part.
'Ignore' means to pay no attention, which is the opposite of looking closely.
The best word is 'analyze.'

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'In math we learned that the hypotenuse is the longest side of a right triangle.' Is the word 'hypotenuse' a general academic word or a domain-specific math word?

steps: A domain-specific word belongs to one field, such as math.
'Hypotenuse' names a part of a right triangle, an idea used only in math.
It is not a word that appears across many subjects.
The word 'hypotenuse' is a domain-specific math word.

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'The findings were so ______ that they changed the way doctors treated the illness.' Which word best completes the sentence: significant or boring?

steps: The clue says the findings changed the way doctors treated an illness, so they were important.
'Significant' means important or having a big effect.
'Boring' means dull and unimportant, which does not fit findings that changed treatment.
The best word is 'significant.'

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'The judges had to ______ each project to decide which one deserved first prize.' Which word best completes the sentence: evaluate or paint?

steps: The clue says the judges had to decide which project deserved first prize.
'Evaluate' means to judge the worth or quality of something.
'Paint' means to apply color and does not match deciding which project is best.
The best word is 'evaluate.'

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'The detective looked for ______ that would prove who had taken the missing keys.' Which word best completes the sentence: evidence or weather?

steps: The clue says the detective wanted something that would prove who took the keys.
'Evidence' means facts or signs that help prove something is true.
'Weather' means the conditions outside and does not fit proving who took the keys.
The best word is 'evidence.'

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'A biologist studied each tiny organism living in the pond water.' Is the word 'organism' a general academic word or a domain-specific science word?

steps: A domain-specific word is tied to one field, such as science.
'Organism' means a living thing and is a term used in the field of biology, which is science.
It is not used as a general word across many different subjects.
The word 'organism' is a domain-specific science word.

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'The students will ______ how the two countries are different by listing the unlike things about each one.' Which word best completes the sentence: contrast or celebrate?

steps: The clue says the students will list the unlike, different things about each country.
'Contrast' means to show how things are different.
'Celebrate' means to honor or have a party and does not match listing differences.
The best word is 'contrast.'

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'The teacher asked us to ______ the main idea of the article in our own words.' Which word best completes the sentence: summarize or sprint?

steps: The clue says to give the main idea of the article in your own words.
'Summarize' means to give the main points briefly in your own words.
'Sprint' means to run fast and has nothing to do with stating a main idea.
The best word is 'summarize.'

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'On the map, the explorers measured the distance to the equator before sailing north.' Is the word 'equator' a general academic word or a domain-specific geography word?

steps: A domain-specific word belongs to one field, such as geography.
'Equator' names an imaginary line around the middle of Earth, an idea used in geography.
It is not a word that appears across many different subjects.
The word 'equator' is a domain-specific geography word.

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'There was not enough ______ space in the classroom, so some students had to stand.' Which word best completes the sentence: sufficient or sleepy?

steps: The clue says there was not enough space, so some students had to stand.
'Sufficient' means enough or as much as is needed.
'Sleepy' means tired and does not describe an amount of space.
The best word is 'sufficient.'

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'The new rule had a ______ effect on the team, changing almost everything about how they practiced.' Which word best completes the sentence: major or quiet?

steps: The clue says the rule changed almost everything about how the team practiced.
'Major' means large or very important.
'Quiet' means making little noise, which does not match changing almost everything.
The best word is 'major.'

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'The principal will ______ the new schedule on the first day so everyone understands it.' Which word best completes the sentence: explain or eat?

steps: The clue says the goal is to make sure everyone understands the schedule.
'Explain' means to make something clear so others can understand it.
'Eat' means to consume food and does not match helping people understand.
The best word is 'explain.'

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'During music class we learned to read the notes printed on the staff.' Is the word 'staff' (the set of lines used to write music) a general academic word or a domain-specific music word?

steps: A domain-specific word is tied to one field, such as music.
Here 'staff' means the set of lines used to write musical notes, a term from the field of music.
Used this way, it does not appear across many different subjects.
The word 'staff' is a domain-specific music word.
